contract: SPEC0209 contract-only extraction; implementation bytes must not be copied

findings.origin: Inherited scope-blind early return, retained in the changed runtime_literals/export_metadata path; applies to both Assign and newly supported AnnAssign processing. Not claimed as a newly introduced regression.
static_trace: Function-local AnnAssign has the sole Name target __all__, an identifier-only literal list value, and the pure annotation list[str]. export_metadata returns true without checking lexical scope.

visit returns at 1022 and skips the local list literal. The function annotation is deliberately skipped as pure metadata. exec(__all__[0]) contains only an identifier and integer index, so no other string occurrence supplies the missing digest.

payload_literals therefore lacks the debugger digest. typ returns ast.unparse for the parameter annotation, copying the string representation 'debugger' into python-function run.shape.parameters[0].type.

With the explicit None return annotation, the function shape contains no UNKNOWN and extraction_status is predicted STATIC. The generic python-surface remains UNKNOWN, but does not prevent or opaquely represent this copied payload. No python-exports row is emitted for the nested assignment.
findings.expected: Retain run and its stable identity/source/digest/owner/parity; make the colliding parameter annotation UNKNOWN with payload digest, byte_length=8, and reason. Keep actual module-level export metadata and declaration-only positive controls exact.
findings.repair_scope: Restrict the export-metadata early-return privilege to established module-level export assignments. Traverse local same-named assignments as runtime expressions. Add inert annotated/unannotated local-scope collision fixtures alongside the existing module-level positive controls; no sink-name blacklist, evaluation, dataflow engine, cross-file proof, or universal opacity claim is needed.
findings.limits: Predicted behavior from source tracing only; no helper/test/witness execution. The unannotated local assignment has the same trace. This is a concrete same-physical-source scope classification error, not a demand to resolve arbitrary aliasing.
